title: A Joomla quickstart built by the CLI installer converts its utf8mb3 tables to utf8mb4, so an emoji is stored instead of failing the write
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with a docker daemon (the test starts its own mariadb:11 container and removes it), run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok, none skipped.
expect: Before the function an emoji written into a utf8mb3 tr_content fails with Incorrect string value; after it the site's tables are utf8mb4_unicode_ci, rows unchanged, and the emoji is stored.
A table the server refuses is named in a !! line and left; the provision function still returns 0; a site already in utf8mb4 prints nothing.
The installer road calls the conversion after the CLI install and before the chown.

tests: the site's utf8mb3 tables move to utf8mb4 with their rows, then hold an emoji; other tables stay
a table the server will not convert is named and left; the others are converted; the provision goes on
a site already in utf8mb4 is left as it is, and says nothing
the CLI installer road converts the tables right after the install, before anything reads the site
